messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to run a tf apply for the network route change during the midnight change window (00:30 UTC). I'll queue deploy-bot and follow the serial AZ plan.
Maria: ack. which workspace + will this touch shared-vpc?
Alex: workspace=prod/network. yes, touches shared-vpc: route tables + TGW attachments.
Jordan: prefer we keep canary and do AZ-by-AZ apply. also recommend provider pin to avoid provider drift (pin to 4.50.0).
Alex: added provider_pin in the PR. plan was run in staging and looks clean. executing serial: us-east-1a -> 1b -> 1c. deploy-bot quiet-mode on.
Maria: request: freeze IAM changes for customer-facing services during the apply window. don’t want accidental role changes.
Alex: good call — will block okta/KMS rotation PRs in that window. also setting an abort-on-failure threshold: 2 failed route ops -> abort + rollback.
deploy-bot: preflight plan check: 1 warning — route53 TTL change detected.
Alex: TTL change is expected, mark as benign and proceed. plan approved after 00:35 UTC. tagging run with "rollback-on-failure" and "manual-eyes".
Jordan: I'll be on-call for the first two AZs. @sre-oncall can you stand by for traffic shift/cutover?
sre-oncall: standing by. will monitor 5m intervals and have the traffic-runbook ready.
Maria: small ask for release notes: mention possible brief degradation for internal admin APIs and call out the specific endpoints.
Alex: will update infra release notes in the repo (infra-release-notes/2026-03-21.md). if we need to rollback, use: `./scripts/traffic-rollback.sh  <snapshot-id>` (tested).
Jordan: linking canary plan: https://ci.internal/plan/631234 (outputs + checks in artifacts).
Alex: ok starting deploy-bot in 30m. confirm readiness please :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: :thumbsup: ready.
Alex: deploy-bot: executing apply-phase-1 (us-east-1a). will post logs to #release-war-room.
deploy-bot: apply succeeded for us-east-1a — changes applied, KV cache primed.
Alex: moving to us-east-1b now.
deploy-bot: apply failed in us-east-1b — error: route table association conflict (resource already associated by another change). rolling back us-east-1b.
Alex: aborting remaining steps and invoking rollback script now. snapshot id `2026-03-21-01`.
sre-oncall: traffic restored to pre-change state, monitoring looks green across metrics.
Maria: updated release notes to call out aborted apply and no customer impact observed.
Jordan: we'll coordinate with the change owner who made the conflicting association and re-plan. reschedule earliest after 24h and re-run full preflight.
Alex: thanks all. scheduling a short postmortem tomorrow 09:30 to capture the conflict, provider pin notes, and improve preflight checks.
